testcase.name: Scenario: Open and exit the free-rotation mode: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-viewport-orbit-source/features/application/viewport-orbit/viewport-orbit.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and exit the free-rotation mode ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the viewport navigation bar is visible ✔ When the user selects the orbit control on the navigation bar ✔ Then the status area indicates free rotation ✔ And the active part remains visible ✔ When the user moves through the viewport using a drag gesture ✔ Then a circular guide with a central cross and radial marks is visible over the viewport ✔ When the user opens the context menu in the viewport ✔ Then it offers Done, OK, Home View, Pan, Zoom and Previous View ✔ When the user chooses Done ✔ Then the circular guide disappears ✔ And the status area displays Ready ✔ And the same part remains active
